# Genesis Apocryphon Column 7 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Genesis Apocryphon Column 7 where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 7:1 — "corrupted its way" vs "turned from the right path"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "had-corrupted its way" | Literal chabbel orcheh |
| LOGOS | "had corrupted its way" | Formal equivalent |
| PNEUMA | "had turned from the right path" | Dynamic interpretation |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "had corrupted its way." The Aramaic phrase echoes Genesis 6:12; PNEUMA's paraphrase loses the direct allusion.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 7:3 — "was filled" vs "was overflowing"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the earth was-filled" | Literal male'at |
| LOGOS | "the earth was filled" | Formal equivalent |
| PNEUMA | "the earth was overflowing" | Dynamic intensification |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "the earth was filled." PNEUMA's "overflowing" intensifies beyond the Aramaic.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 7:4 — "corruption" vs "depravity"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "with corruption" | Literal chabbala |
| LOGOS | "with corruption" | Standard rendering |
| PNEUMA | "with depravity" | Dynamic synonym |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET/LOGOS "with corruption." Closer to the Aramaic root ch-b-l; "depravity" shifts the semantic field.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 7:5 — "saw" vs "looked upon" vs "looked down upon"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "God saw" | Literal chaza |
| LOGOS | "God looked upon" | Formal with added preposition |
| PNEUMA | "God looked down upon" | Dynamic with spatial imagery |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "God looked upon." Slightly more evocative than bare "saw" without PNEUMA's spatial addition.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

*Total disagreements: 4*
*Resolution: LOGOS 3, EMET/LOGOS 1, EMET 0, PNEUMA 0, Compromise 0*
